context: A small konbini, after dinner. Sho is buying snacks alone for the first time. Goro, in town visiting, is at the counter ahead of him.
purpose: tiny incidental encounter — old man notices small boy

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.style: A slow Kyushu line of recognition. Half-smile audible.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: A careful one-word answer. Eyes on the snacks.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: お金、足りるか。本当に大丈夫か。
lines.en: You got enough money? Truly alright?
lines.style: A small kind check. Voice low and gentle.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 足ります。お母さんが、ちゃんと。
lines.en: I have enough. Mom — gave it to me properly.
lines.style: A small proud full sentence. Eight-year-old dignity.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: ええな。気ぃつけて帰りなさい。
lines.style: A small grandfather-line, no fuss — voice carries the moment fully.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。
lines.style: A small full keigo bow. Real for a five-year-old.
